'''Alex Mcmillan''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[January 2001 Hatfield tournament]] on 21 January 2001, according to Jamie Giberti's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1662">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-23-hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebsd1662/ hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebs], DeckTech (Jamie "JEEBS" Giberti, 23 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-23-hatfield-england-17-01-2k1-by-jeebsd1662/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
